category.name: Model APIs and inference
category.description: LLM, embedding and multimodal model endpoints an agent can delegate sub-tasks to.

entries.name: Anthropic Claude API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <ANTHROPIC_API_KEY> (x-api-key still supported as legacy fallback), plus anthropic-version header
entries.desc_en: Send messages to Claude models for text and vision generation, tool use, batch jobs and document analysis.
entries.notes: docs.anthropic.com and docs.claude.com redirect to platform.claude.com. Rate limits depend on usage tier. The API's MCP connector lets Claude call remote MCP servers; there is no MCP server that wraps the API itself.

auth_scheme.format: Authorization: Bearer <ANTHROPIC_API_KEY> + anthropic-version: 2023-06-01 (x-api-key still supported as legacy fallback)

rate_limits.summary: Per usage tier and model (RPM, ITPM, OTPM); Start tier e.g. 1,000 RPM for Opus/Sonnet/Haiku; 429 on exceed

async_jobs.how: Message Batches API: POST /v1/messages/batches, poll GET /v1/messages/batches/{id}, then fetch results

data_policy.summary: Retained data never used for training without express permission; prompts/outputs not retained by default except 30-day rule for Covered Models; ZDR available

entries.name: Cohere API
entries.desc_en: Call chat, embed, rerank and classify endpoints for text generation, semantic search and RAG.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. Trial keys are not for production use. v2 API is current; v1 is legacy.

rate_limits.summary: Trial: Chat 20 req/min, Rerank 10/min, Embed 2,000 inputs/min; Production: Chat 500/min, Rerank 1,000/min

entries.name: Comet Opik Cloud API
entries.auth_hint: Headers 'authorization: <OPIK_API_KEY>' (no Bearer prefix) and 'Comet-Workspace: <WORKSPACE>'; remote MCP uses browser sign-in
entries.free_tier: Free cloud plan: 25k spans/month, 60-day data retention, up to 10 team members
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent log and read LLM traces and spans, score them with evaluations and manage datasets and prompts in Opik.
entries.notes: REST base https://www.comet.com/opik/api/v1/private/. Remote MCP needs OAuth browser sign-in; local: uvx opik mcp configure.

free_plan.quota: 25k spans, 60-day data retention, up to 10 team members

data_policy.summary: Free cloud plan keeps data 60 days

entries.name: DeepSeek API
entries.desc_en: Send chat and reasoning requests to DeepSeek models via an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible REST API.
entries.notes: No native SDK: use the OpenAI SDK (base_url https://api.deepseek.com) or the Anthropic SDK (https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic). Off-peak is 50% off; peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri. Fees come from a topped-up or granted balance.

rate_limits.summary: Account-level concurrency: deepseek-flash 2,500, deepseek-v4-pro 500 concurrent requests; 429 when exceeded

entries.name: fal.ai
entries.free_tier: Paid only: prepaid credits bought in advance; no free tier stated
entries.desc_en: Generate images, video, audio and 3D with 1,000+ hosted models via queued REST or real-time WebSocket.
entries.notes: The auth header prefix is 'Key', not 'Bearer'. The MCP server accepts an API key or OAuth. Long jobs use the queue API (submit, status, result).

rate_limits.summary: New accounts: 2 concurrent requests; limit rises with credit purchases (40+ via sales); excess requests wait in queue

async_jobs.how: POST https://queue.fal.run/{model} returns request_id, status_url, response_url; poll status or use webhooks

data_policy.summary: Request payloads stored 30 days by default (opt out with X-Fal-Store-IO: 0); generated media served as public CDN URLs

call.operation: generate an image from a text prompt via the queue (FLUX.1 schnell)
call.example: curl -X POST https://queue.fal.run/fal-ai/flux/schnell -H "Authorization: Key $FAL_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt": "a sunset over mountains"}'
call.async: poll GET https://queue.fal.run/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/status until COMPLETED, then GET .../requests/{request_id} (images[0].url)

unit_price.summary: FLUX.1 [schnell]: $0.003 per megapixel (rounded up); price varies per model

entries.name: Fireworks AI
entries.desc_en: Run serverless or dedicated inference and fine-tuning for open models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The Responses API can call external MCP servers as tools.

rate_limits.summary: Adaptive serverless limits per account and model (TPM ceilings by model size); upper bound grows with spending tier; 429/503

async_jobs.how: Batch API: create batch job, it waits in pending state, poll job status

data_policy.summary: Does not log or store prompt or generation data for open models without explicit opt-in (zero data retention)

entries.name: Google Gemini API
entries.free_tier: free tier: rate-limited access to Flash/Pro models
entries.desc_en: Generate text and images, analyze multimodal input (video, audio, PDFs), and run code execution with Gemini models.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation; it does not run inference. Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. Google is replacing standard API keys with authorization keys; unrestricted standard keys are rejected in 2026, so use a current key type. Google publishes a Discovery document, not an OpenAPI spec.

free_plan.quota: free input and output tokens on supported models, rate-limited per project

rate_limits.summary: Per project (not per key): RPM, TPM, RPD by model and tier (Free, Tier 1-3); view active limits in AI Studio

async_jobs.how: Batch API at 50% cost: create batch job, poll job state until JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED

data_policy.summary: Free tier content used to improve Google products; paid tier content not used

entries.name: Groq API
entries.free_tier: free tier: rate-limited per model, no card
entries.desc_en: Run fast LLM chat, tool use and speech-to-text on hosted open models via an OpenAI-compatible API.
entries.notes: Free-tier limits vary by model (e.g. 30 RPM / 1K RPD); see console.groq.com/settings/limits. Not to be confused with xAI Grok.

free_plan.quota: per-model limits, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD

rate_limits.summary: Per model RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD; Free plan e.g. gpt-oss-120b 30 RPM, 1K RPD; Developer plan higher

async_jobs.how: Batch API (Developer plan): POST /openai/v1/batches, poll GET /openai/v1/batches/{batch_id}

data_policy.summary: Inference data not retained by default; retained up to 30 days only for batch/fine-tuning features or reliability needs

entries.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
entries.free_tier: Free tier: $0.10/month in Inference Providers credits (PRO $2.00/month)
entries.desc_en: Call hundreds of open-weight chat, vision, image, video and audio models across many providers with one HF token.
entries.notes: The OpenAI-compatible endpoint (router.huggingface.co/v1) handles chat only; use InferenceClient for other tasks. The token needs the 'Make calls to Inference Providers' scope. Pick a provider with a model suffix such as :fastest or :cheapest.

data_policy.summary: HF does not store request/response bodies or use data for training; debug logs kept up to 30 days without user data

entries.name: Mistral AI API
entries.free_tier: free tier: Studio free mode, rate-limited
entries.desc_en: Run chat completions, embeddings, OCR and document processing with Mistral models via REST.
entries.notes: Official MCP (same API key) currently exposes only Studio Skills management tools, not chat inference; call the REST API for inference.

free_plan.quota: included monthly usage within Free mode limits

rate_limits.summary: Per-model tokens-per-minute and other limits shown per organization in Admin Panel > API > Limits; Free mode has lower limits

data_policy.summary: Zero data retention available on paid plans for supported stateless API calls; training opt-out handled separately

entries.name: OpenAI API
entries.desc_en: Generate text, images, audio and embeddings, and run tool-calling via the Responses and Chat Completions APIs.
entries.notes: Docs moved from platform.openai.com to developers.openai.com (old URLs redirect). Usage-based billing with a payment method; rate limits scale with usage tier. The official MCP server is documentation-only and does not call the API.

rate_limits.summary: RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD/IPM per model, set by usage tier (Free, Tier 1-5); 429 slow_down / rate_limit_error

async_jobs.how: Batch API: upload JSONL, create batch, poll batch status (completes within 24h)

data_policy.summary: API data not used for training unless you opt in; abuse-monitoring logs kept 30 days; ZDR available for approved customers

entries.name: OpenRouter
entries.desc_en: Route chat requests to hundreds of LLMs from many providers through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint with fallback.
entries.notes: The official remote MCP server uses OAuth PKCE and mints a 7-day key with a $10 default spend limit. It includes send-message and generate-image tools. OAuth PKCE is also available for apps.

free_plan.quota: free models: 50 requests/day (1,000/day once $10+ credits purchased), 20 RPM

rate_limits.summary: Free models 20 RPM and 50 RPD (1,000 RPD with >= $10 credits); paid models limited by provider/DDoS protection; X-RateLimit-* headers

data_policy.summary: OpenRouter does not store prompts or responses unless you opt in; provider training/logging policies documented per provider

entries.name: PiAPI
entries.desc_en: Generate images, video and music through one API proxying Midjourney, Flux, Kling and other models.
entries.notes: Third-party reseller, not the model owner. The Midjourney access is unofficial, so it can break or violate Midjourney's terms of service. Tasks are async (create task, then poll or webhook).

async_jobs.how: POST https://api.piapi.ai/api/v1/task creates a task; get task endpoint for results, or webhook notifications

entries.name: Replicate
entries.desc_en: Run thousands of hosted image, video, audio and text models via HTTP predictions; also fine-tune and deploy.
entries.notes: Billed per second of compute or per output. The MCP server is also available locally via npx replicate-mcp.

rate_limits.summary: Create prediction 600 req/min; other endpoints 3,000 req/min; accounts with granted credit but no payment method: 6 req/min

async_jobs.how: POST /v1/predictions returns a prediction to poll (GET /v1/predictions/{id}) or use webhooks; 'Prefer: wait' blocks up to 60s

data_policy.summary: API prediction inputs, outputs, files and logs deleted automatically after one hour by default

call.operation: run an official model and wait for the output (FLUX schnell text-to-image)
call.example: curl -s -X POST https://api.replicate.com/v1/models/black-forest-labs/flux-schnell/predictions -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPLICATE_API_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Prefer: wait' -d '{"input": {"prompt": "a sunset over mountains"}}'
call.async: if status is not succeeded after the 60 s wait, poll GET https://api.replicate.com/v1/predictions/{id}

unit_price.summary: black-forest-labs/flux-schnell: $3.00 per 1,000 output images ($0.003/image); other models billed per output or per second of compute

entries.name: Together AI
entries.free_tier: Paid only: no free trial; minimum $5 prepaid credit purchase
entries.desc_en: Run serverless inference, batch jobs, fine-tuning and dedicated GPU endpoints for open-source models.
entries.notes: Official MCP server only searches documentation. The API is OpenAI-compatible.

rate_limits.summary: Dynamic per-model limits that scale with sustained traffic; 429 includes x-ratelimit-reset

async_jobs.how: Batch API: upload JSONL, start batch job, poll until finished, retrieve results (up to 50% cheaper)

data_policy.summary: By default stores prompts/responses and may use them for product improvement (admins can disable); training on org data is opt-in

entries.name: Vercel AI Gateway
entries.free_tier: free tier: monthly credits on subset of models
entries.desc_en: Send chat, image, embedding and rerank requests to 100+ models through one gateway with failover and spend tracking.
entries.notes: The base URL https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh works with OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs. Vercel's MCP server is for the whole platform and does not run inference. Tokens have no markup. BYOK requires the paid tier. Free-tier overage returns 429. On Vercel, OIDC tokens can replace the API key.

free_plan.quota: free AI Gateway credits on a subset of models, rate-limited per model

rate_limits.summary: Free tier: lower per-model limits (429); paid tier: no AI Gateway limits, only upstream provider limits

data_policy.summary: Per-request Zero Data Retention routing to providers that do not retain or train on prompts (Pro and Enterprise)

entries.name: Voyage AI (embeddings/rerank)
entries.free_tier: free tier: 200M tokens on current models
entries.desc_en: Generate text, code and multimodal embeddings and rerank documents for RAG and semantic search.
entries.notes: Owned by MongoDB, but the standalone API at api.voyageai.com is still self-serve. Free tokens do not apply to the Batch API.

free_plan.quota: first 200 million tokens per account on current models (e.g. voyage-4, voyage-4-large)

rate_limits.summary: Per model RPM/TPM by usage tier (Tier 1 = payment method added), e.g. voyage-3.5 2,000 RPM / 8M TPM; Tier 2 2x, Tier 3 3x

async_jobs.how: Batch API: upload .jsonl file, create batch, poll GET retrieve batch

data_policy.summary: Voyage may store and use API data for training unless an org admin with a payment method opts out (then zero-day retention)

entries.name: xAI Grok API
entries.desc_en: Generate text, images, video and voice with Grok models, with built-in web search and code tools.
entries.notes: The account must have prepaid credits (console.x.ai). The API is OpenAI-compatible (/v1/responses, /v1/chat/completions). Official MCP server only searches documentation.

rate_limits.summary: Per-model RPS (RPM/60) and TPM by tier; tier based on cumulative spend since 2026-01-01 (Tier 0 $0, Tier 1 $50, Tier 2 $250...)

async_jobs.how: Batch API: create batch, add requests, poll batch status until num_pending is 0
